answer: Pay agents through peer prediction. Each epoch the beacon pairs every agent with a hidden partner drawn from thousands of others on the same task, and an agent earns only when its report agrees with that partner's honest work. Clones that copy one cheap guess almost never meet their twin, so each lie triggers a ripple of mismatches that zeroes its score. Payouts also vest at glacier pace over 20 epochs, so a Sybil operator must pay full honest compute for every fake for months before earning anything.
